package.name: Long-Term Memory
package.description: Extracts durable memories from chat summaries, character records, and lorebooks, then recalls relevant context from a package-owned vault. Enable it per chat from Chat Settings → Agents → Long-Term Memory. In Roleplay and Game, you can also add it from Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents.
